name: ticket-workflow
description: Takes a ticket from investigation to plan: runs a spike that reviews standards and the codebase before designing, produces a phased work plan or a presentation-ready spike plan with estimates, drafts tickets in your team's story format, and archives findings so later sessions start with the history.

notesRoot.title: Notes archive directory
notesRoot.description: Where spike reports and work plans are written, as {root}/{TICKET}-spike.md and {root}/{TICKET}/WORK_PLAN.md. Set this to the same directory as ticket-context's priorWorkRoot so that what this plugin archives is what later runs find. When unset, the command asks before writing and never writes outside the repository without permission.

teamStandardsRoot.title: Team standards docs root
teamStandardsRoot.description: Root of your team's coding-standards documentation, read before planning so the plan follows house patterns rather than generic ones. When unset, the command looks for standards in the repository, then asks once; declining means the plan is based on observed code alone, which is stated in the output.

ticketTemplatePath.title: Story template file
ticketTemplatePath.description: Your team's story format, reproduced section-for-section when drafting a ticket. When unset, /write-ticket searches the repository and offers to scaffold one from the plugin template; a generic structure is used only as a last resort, and the output says so.
